docFindings.doc: .agent_context/lark_remote/docs_md/346｜I18n Locale Detection 与 Provider 详解.md and .agent_context/final_review/docs_md/346｜I18n Locale Detection 与 Provider 详解.md
evidence: Doc 346 diagram suggests `Cookie --> ServerDetect` is the complete path: remote/local 346 lines 15-24.

Actual runtime has two phases: server root layout calls `detectLocaleServer()` from cookie only, then client `useI18n()` runs an effect that reads cookie or falls back to `navigator.language` and writes cookie: `frontend/src/app/layout.tsx:15-24`, `frontend/src/core/i18n/server.ts:6-18`, `frontend/src/core/i18n/hooks.ts:21-41`, `frontend/src/core/i18n/locale.ts:43-54`.
Appearance settings calls `changeLocale(value)` from the language select: `frontend/src/components/workspace/settings/appearance-settings-page.tsx:86-108`.
docFindings.issue: Doc 346 misses the server-client locale transition and fallback behavior. The current diagram is too static for a learner trying to debug language selection or hydration-time locale changes.
docFindings.patch:
After the first Mermaid block in both local and remote 346, insert:

```md

## Locale 状态流转补充

| 阶段 | 源码 | 行为 |
|-|-|-|
| SSR 初始值 | `frontend/src/app/layout.tsx`、`frontend/src/core/i18n/server.ts` | 只从 `locale` cookie 读取并 `normalizeLocale`，没有 cookie 时默认 `en-US`。 |
| Client 初始化 | `frontend/src/core/i18n/hooks.ts` | mount 后先读 `document.cookie`，没有 cookie 才用 `navigator.language` 检测，并写回 cookie。 |
| 用户切换 | `appearance-settings-page.tsx` | Select 调 `changeLocale()`，更新 React context 并写 cookie。 |
```

result.summary: Remaining issues are concentrated in stale remote snapshots and a few source-inaccurate template paragraphs. Canonical local docs already fix several P0/P1 learner-guide problems, but remote 355 is truncated, remote 354 still overclaims full verification, and remote 349/353 miss the new JS learner route/checklist. Source-level doc gaps remain in setup wizard, i18n, provisioner, and workspace settings state transitions.

visualTasks.spec:
Replace/supplement the straight-line diagram with:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Start[Provisioner startup] --> WaitKubeconfig[wait for KUBECONFIG_PATH]
  WaitKubeconfig --> KubePath{path exists}
  KubePath -->|file| LoadKube[load kubeconfig]
  KubePath -->|directory| Fatal[clear runtime error]
  KubePath -->|missing after timeout| InCluster[try in-cluster config]
  LoadKube --> Namespace[ensure namespace]
  InCluster --> Namespace
  Namespace --> Ready[FastAPI ready]
  Ready --> Create[POST /api/sandboxes]
  Create --> Existing{existing NodePort}
  Existing -->|yes| ReturnExisting[return URL + pod phase]
  Existing -->|no| Volumes{PVC env vars}
  Volumes -->|PVC| PVCMount[user scoped subPath]
  Volumes -->|hostPath| HostMount[thread hostPath]
  PVCMount --> Pod[create Pod]
  HostMount --> Pod
  Pod --> Service[create NodePort Service]
  Service -->|failure| Rollback[delete Pod and return 500]
```

visualTasks.spec:
Replace current locale diagram with:
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> ServerRender
  ServerRender --> CookieFound: locale cookie exists
  ServerRender --> DefaultLocale: no cookie
  CookieFound --> InitialProvider: normalizeLocale(cookie)
  DefaultLocale --> InitialProvider: en-US
  InitialProvider --> ClientMounted
  ClientMounted --> ClientCookie: document.cookie has locale
  ClientMounted --> NavigatorDetect: no locale cookie
  ClientCookie --> ProviderLocale: normalize saved cookie
  NavigatorDetect --> ProviderLocale: normalize navigator.language
  ProviderLocale --> CookieWrite: write normalized locale
  ProviderLocale --> ComponentText: translations[locale]
  ComponentText --> UserSwitch: Appearance language select
  UserSwitch --> ProviderLocale: changeLocale(newLocale)
```
